On H200 SXM5, TF32 Tensor Cores deliver ~989 TFLOPS vs ~67 TFLOPS for FP32 FFMA — a ~14.7x peak throughput advantage. The NCU HighPipeUtilization rule (90.41% speedup) confirms all compute pipelines are severely under-utilized. The scheduler shows only 0.13 eligible warps/cycle (87.45% no-eligible cycles), indicating the GPU is starved for compute work. With K=192 (small accumulation depth), TF32 mantissa truncation (23→10 bits) introduces negligible accumulated error for a convolution+bias epilogue, making this a safe precision trade-off.
